description: This file implements Ethernet switch control functions for a Raspberry Pi platform, including port status, configuration, admin status, MAC address location, and Ethernet WAN link status, with callback registration and thread handling for link detection events.

methods.name: is_interface_exists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface exists by path.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwInit
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet switch control, starts thread for link detection if feature enabled.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current port status including link rate, duplex mode, and link status.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortCfg
methods.description: Retrieves current port configuration such as speed and duplex mode.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortCfg
methods.description: Sets port configuration like speed and duplex mode.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwGetPortAdminStatus
methods.description: Gets administrative status (up/down) of a port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetPortAdminStatus
methods.description: Sets administrative status (up/down) of a port.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwSetAgingSpeed
methods.description: Sets aging speed for a port (stub implementation).

methods.name: get_port_number
methods.description: Retrieves the port number associated with eth1 interface.

methods.name: CcspHalEthSwLocatePortByMacAddress
methods.description: Finds the port associated with a given MAC address.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves interface name from a configuration file.

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_getAssociatedDevice
methods.description: Gets list of active wired clients with MAC addresses and associated info.

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_getEthWanEnable
methods.description: Returns whether Ethernet WAN is enabled (stub: always true).

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_getEthWanPort
methods.description: Returns the Ethernet WAN port (stub: always 0).

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_setEthWanEnable
methods.description: Sets Ethernet WAN enable status (stub).

methods.name: CcspHalExtSw_setEthWanPort
methods.description: Sets Ethernet WAN port (stub).

methods.name: rpiNet_isInterfaceLinkUp
methods.description: Checks if a network interface link is up.

methods.name: GWP_GetEthWanLinkStatus
methods.description: Returns Ethernet WAN link status.

methods.name: GWP_GetEthWanInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns the Ethernet WAN interface name.

methods.name: GWP_RegisterEthWan_Callback
methods.description: Registers callback functions for link up/down events.
